svg.text: 3D-printed sand mould from step/blade.step with 4 mm machining allowance on both faces
Cast CA6NM; one test bar per heat
Visual, PT (ISO 3452), UT of root (ASTM A609); weld-repair to procedure and re-heat-treat
Rough then finish both faces and edges to the CAD model; leave root datum
Blend edges, polish to Ra ≤ 3.2 µm; mark blade number
Machine the root face and bolt holes to the trunnion
Final PT; weigh each blade; blades within 1 % of each other
Turn all over to drawing TL-KAP-004; seat to h7
Drill and tap bolt pattern, pin bore
Pattern and cores from the hub profile (TL-KAP-005), 60 mm wall
UT of seat zones, MT after machining
Turn outer profile and the shaft flange face
Bore 5 trunnion seats H7 at 72°, faces square
Fit trunnions and blades; set blade angle ±0.1°; balance G6.3 (ISO 21940-11)
TEACHING MODEL — materials, tolerances and wall thicknesses are assumptions. Not for construction.
